body:
## Robot compatibility note for the local EnvironmentBackend migration

Current Actions Runtime initializes separate RCC instances/homes for Actions and Robots primarily to avoid Holotree lock contention, and the Robot API has its own RCC execution path. Treat that as implementation/migration debt, not a future semantic boundary.

#144 requires Robot Tasks to consume the same EnvironmentBackend lifecycle:

`resolve/acquire -> verify/materialize -> lease -> Execution Handle -> spawn/reap -> release`

Do not block #134 on completing first-class Robots, but design its interface so #144 can plug Robot Task command/PATH/PYTHONPATH/preRun semantics into the same backend without creating `RobotEnvironmentBackend` or durable Robot-specific RCC identity.

Separate local roots/materializations may remain under explicit isolation/performance policy; the fact that one root is called `robots_home` must never become Package/Environment/Run identity.
